agyos_skill.intent: Seek and analyze video content using Memories.ai Large Visual Memory Model for persistent video intelligence
agyos_skill.instructions: Use this skill when the user wants to search for, import, or analyze video content from TikTok, YouTube, or Instagram, summarize meetings or lectures from recordings, build a searchable knowledge base from video content, or research social media trends and creators. This skill enables AI agents to search, import, and analyze video content using Memories.ai's Large Visual Memory Model (LVMM). Unlike one-shot video analysis tools, it provides persistent video intelligence -- videos are indexed once and can be queried repeatedly across sessions. Supports social media import (TikTok, YouTube, Instagram), meeting summarization, knowledge base building, and cross-video Q&A via Memory Augmented Generation (MAG). The skill wraps 21 API commands into workflow-oriented reference guides that agents load on demand. A routing table in SKILL.md maps user intent to the right workflow automatically. - Use when analyzing or asking questions about a video from a URL - Use when searching for videos on TikTok, YouTube, or Instagram by topic, hashtag, or creator - Use when summarizing meetings, lectures, or webinars from recordings - Use when building a searchable knowledge base from video content and text memories - Use when researching social media content trends, influencers, or viral patterns - Use when analyzing or describing images with AI vision The agent reads the SKILL.md workflow router and matches the user's request to one of 6 intent categories. The agent loads the appropriate reference file (e.g., video_qa.md for video questions, social_research.md for social media research). The agent follows the step-by-step workflow: upload/import -> wait for processing -> analyze/chat -> present results. ``` User: "What are the key arguments in this video? https://youtube.com/watch?v=abc123" Agent: uploads video -> waits for processing -> uses chat_video to ask questions -> presents structured summary ``` ``` User: "What's trending on TikTok about sustainable fashion?" Agent: uses search_public to find trending videos -> imports top results -> analyzes content patterns ``` ``` User: "Summarize this meeting recording and extract action items" Agent: uploads recording -> waits -> gets transcript -> uses chat_video for structured summary with action items ``` - Always wait for video processing to complete before querying
